profile_text.body:
The Machine Intelligence Research Institute, or MIRI, is a nonprofit organization founded in 2000 and headquartered in Berkeley, California, United States. Its website is intelligence.org. The organization describes itself as focused on preventing human extinction from artificial superintelligence.

MIRI says it has worked for over two decades to understand and prepare for the challenges it expects humanity to face in a transition to a world with artificial superintelligence. It states that its technical and philosophical work helped found the field of AI alignment, and that its researchers originated many of the theories and concepts central to current discussions of AI. The organization also says that recent rapid advances at the frontier of artificial intelligence have sharply shortened estimates of when superintelligence will arrive, that technical progress on safety, alignment, and control has failed to keep up, and that humanity does not understand the internal workings of present systems well enough to fully control them or robustly steer their behavior.

The profile lists no products and no MCP servers for the organization, and no lawsuits are recorded. California is listed as a jurisdiction with a count of 237.
